units.source_text: 说实在的，假病也并不好受。

en.t: To tell the truth, pretending to be sick was not pleasant either.

units.source_text: 简直像手里紧紧握着快要弹开的发条似的。

en.t: It was exactly like gripping a spring in his hand that was about to snap open.

units.source_text: 不可能一直这样忍耐下去。

en.t: It was impossible to go on enduring things like this forever.
Letting things take their natural course was absolutely forbidden.

units.source_text: 必须让他们彻底明白，对他们来说，自己的存在是多么沉重的负担。

en.t: He had to make them understand completely what a heavy burden his existence was to them.

units.source_text: 今天无论如何不能让女人睡一分钟！

en.t: Today, no matter what, he could not let the woman sleep for even a minute!
